messages.O singură familie de curbe: cerc, elipsă: One family of curves: circle, ellipse, parabola, and hyperbola
messages.Planul perpendicular pe axă taie un cerc: A plane perpendicular to the axis cuts a circle.
messages.Planul înclinat taie o singură pânză: el: An inclined plane cuts one cone nappe: an ellipse.
messages.Plan paralel cu o generatoare produce o: A plane parallel to a cone generator produces a parabola.
messages.Planul taie ambele pânze ale conului: hi: The plane cuts both nappes of the cone: a hyperbola.
messages.e = 0: cazul particular al cercului. Foc: e = 0: the special case of a circle. Its focus coincides with its center.
messages.0 < e < 1: suma distanțelor la focare es: 0 < e < 1: the sum of the distances to the foci is constant. The shape becomes more elongated as e increases.
messages.e = 1: distanța la focar este egală cu d: e = 1: distance to the focus equals distance to the directrix. The curve has one branch.
messages.e > 1: diferența distanțelor la focare e: e > 1: the absolute difference between distances to the foci is constant. The curve has two branches.
messages.Cercul este cazul particular în care foc: A circle is the special case where the foci coincide and e = 0.
messages.Elipsă: punctul P păstrează raportul PF: Ellipse: point P keeps the ratio PF / PD = e for the focus and directrix.
messages.Parabolă: punctul P păstrează raportul P: Parabola: point P keeps the ratio PF / PD = e for the focus and directrix.
messages.Hiperbolă: punctul P păstrează raportul: Hyperbola: point P keeps the ratio PF / PD = e for the focus and directrix.
messages.Distanța de la centru la orice punct al: Distance from the center to any point on the circle.
messages.Semiaxa mare. Semiaxa mică b depinde de: Major semi-axis. The minor semi-axis b depends on eccentricity.
messages.Distanța focală este p/2; p controlează: The focal distance is p/2; p controls the parabola's width.
messages.Semiaxa transversală; ramurile se deschi: Transverse semi-axis; the branches open to the left and right.
messages.Cu cât e este mai mare, cu atât elipsa e: The larger e is, the more elongated the ellipse.
messages.Hiperbola are e > 1; creșterea lui e des: A hyperbola has e > 1; increasing e widens its branches.
messages.Ce urmărești în animație?: What to watch in the animation
messages.Alege o fișă pentru a o încărca în labor: Choose a card to load it into the laboratory above.
messages.Mulțimea punctelor egal depărtate de un: The set of points at an equal distance from a fixed point called the center.
messages.Locul punctelor pentru care suma distanț: The locus of points for which the sum of the distances to two foci is constant.
messages.Punctele egal depărtate de un focar și d: Points that are equally distant from a focus and a fixed line called the directrix.
messages.Locul punctelor pentru care diferența di: The locus of points for which the difference between the distances to two foci is constant.
messages.Toate conicele pot fi descrise cu un foc: Every conic can be described using a focus F, a directrix d, and a positive number e called eccentricity. A point P lies on the conic if:

messages.Excentricitatea măsoară cât de alungită: Eccentricity measures how elongated the curve is. It controls the shape, not only its size.
messages.Cum recunoști conica dintr-o ecuație?: How to identify a conic from its equation
messages.Forma generală a unei conice este:: The general form of a conic equation is:
messages.Discriminantul Δ = B² − 4AC ne spune tip: The discriminant Δ = B² − 4AC identifies the type of curve (for a non-degenerate conic):
messages.ne spune tipul curbei (în cazul nedegene: identifies the type of curve (for a non-degenerate conic):
messages.Termenul Bxy apare când conica este roti: The term Bxy appears when the conic is rotated relative to the coordinate axes. This lesson uses canonical form, with its axes parallel to the coordinate axes.
messages.apare când conica este rotită față de ax: appears when the conic is rotated relative to the coordinate axes. This lesson uses canonical form, with its axes parallel to the coordinate axes.
messages.a și b sunt semiaxele, iar c este distan: a and b are the semi-axes, and c is the distance from the center to the foci. An ellipse has its foci inside; a hyperbola's foci lie on the axis not crossed by its branches.
messages.este distanța de la centru la focare. La: is the distance from the center to the foci. An ellipse has its foci inside; a hyperbola's foci lie on the axis not crossed by its branches.
messages.La parabolă, distanța de la vârf la foca: For a parabola, the vertex-to-focus distance is p/2, and the directrix is symmetric about the vertex.
For a parabola, the vertex-to-focus distance is
messages.iar directoarea este simetrică față de v: and the directrix is symmetric about the vertex.
messages.Numele vine din faptul că toate apar pri: The name comes from producing them by cutting a double circular cone with a plane. A double cone has two nappes that meet at the vertex.
messages.Unghiul planului față de axă schimbă tip: The angle of the plane relative to the axis changes the type of curve.
messages.Poziția planului schimbă dimensiunea și: The plane's position changes the curve's size and opening.
messages.Dacă planul trece prin vârf, putem obțin: If the plane passes through the vertex, degenerate cases can occur: a point, a line, or two lines.
messages.Încearcă să modifici parametrii din labo: Try changing the laboratory parameters and watch the plane, curve, and equation change together.
messages.De ce aceeași definiție funcționează?: Why does the same definition work?
messages.Focarul este în origine, iar directoarea: The focus is at the origin, and the directrix has equation x = d. For a hyperbola, the first expression describes the branch x < d and the second the branch x > d; for an ellipse and a parabola, use the first expression. Angle θ is measured from the focal axis.
messages.Excentricitatea orbitei Pământului este: Earth's orbital eccentricity is about 0.0167, so its orbit is nearly circular. The Sun lies at focus F₁, with F₂ very close by.
messages.Alege un răspuns pentru fiecare întrebar: Choose one answer for each question. Feedback appears immediately.
messages.Începe cu prima întrebare. Fiecare răspu: Start with the first question. Each correct answer brings you closer to 6/6.
messages.Leagă definițiile, ecuațiile, excentrici: Connect definitions, equations, eccentricity, and applications in one view.
messages.Centrul este familia conicelor. Ramurile: The center is the family of conics. Its branches are the circle, ellipse, parabola, and hyperbola, each with its eccentricity, equation, and application.
messages.În câmp gravitațional, corpurile legate: In a gravitational field, bound bodies move on ellipses
messages.Fără rezistența aerului, traiectoria unu: Without air resistance, the trajectory of an obliquely launched projectile is a parabola.
messages.Locurile cu aceeași diferență de timp fo: Locations with the same time difference form a hyperbola.
messages.Razele paralele cu axa unei parabole se: Rays parallel to a parabola's axis reflect toward its focus.
messages.Într-o încăpere eliptică, un sunet emis: In an elliptical room, a sound emitted at one focus reflects toward the other focus.
messages.În modelul ideal cu două corpuri, corpur: In the ideal two-body model, bound bodies move on ellipses, with the Sun at one focus.
messages.Un corp care se mișcă pe un cerc cu modu: An object moving on a circle at constant speed has acceleration directed toward the center.
messages.Cercul este cazul particular al elipsei: A circle is the special case of an ellipse whose foci coincide.
